notes.title: Soul Drifter 1.5 is live!
notes.content:
Our biggest update yet, adressing the most requested feature: Steam Achievements

To celebrate this huge update we decided to discount Soul Drifter by 60%.


 16 unlockable steam achievements
 A lot more hidden notes 
 Improved later parkour stages 
 Added subtitles for all cutscenes
 Visual improvements in UI
 Added dynamic layering to music for all boss stages
 More detailed setdressed levels
 Added shortcut to restart from last checkpoint
 More savepoints
 New dynamic speedlines effect


If you do like Soul Drifter, we'd really appreciate you leaving a review!

notes.title: Update for 29. December 2024
notes.content:
With this update we adressed a lot feedback you gave us:

- Game saves more frequently
- Added more checkpoints to the first three chapters
- Added more lore notes to the first three chapters
- Rebalanced the boss-stages
- Various level design improvements

Thank you so much for playing! 

PS: Achievments are currently worked on :)

notes.title: Soul Drifter is Out Now!
notes.content:
Soul Drifter is officially OUT NOW! 

We're so excited to share our high-flying parkour game with you! Enjoy running, jumping, and gliding into a surreal underwater world with a arsenal of smooth moves and satisfying action. We will be running a launch discount of 15% for the first week, so make sure to snap it up before then! And please leave a review -- it goes a long way to help small teams like ours get more visibility on Steam!

Want to try before you buy? We're leaving our demo available for you to play before you purchase the full game! (Note: the demo is an altered & condensed version of early levels, so progress cannot be transferred!)

Thanks for playing! Please help spread the word by sharing our announcements on social media:

 Instagram
 Twitter
